What I work on

Applied AI, from the paper to the production system

My doctoral work was in natural language processing — sarcasm, sentiment, opinion mining at scale. That grounding now sits underneath the systems I lead: multi-agent applications, retrieval architectures and domain-adapted language models built for regulated industries.

01

Agentic AI systems

Multi-agent applications on LangGraph, CrewAI and Google ADK — clinical decision support, financial fraud detection, property evaluation — coordinated over MCP and A2A protocols, with observability through LangSmith and Langfuse.

02

Retrieval at enterprise scale

Advanced RAG for regulatory, financial and clinical corpora: hybrid BM25 and vector search, query expansion, HyDE, re-ranking and contextual compression, evaluated with RAGAS, TruLens and DeepEval.

03

Domain-adapted language models

Continued pre-training and fine-tuning of small language models — Phi-3, Qwen 7B, Llama-3 — on healthcare data using LoRA and QLoRA, where a smaller specialised model beats a larger general one.

04

Responsible AI & governance

Governance frameworks for models in production: fairness testing, bias detection, SHAP-based explainability, guardrails and monitoring dashboards built for compliance teams rather than for demos.

Career

Two tracks, one subject

Seven years in enterprise AI delivery, preceded by fourteen in engineering education — including four years as the Infosys and Cognizant single point of contact for a university of 30,000 students.
